name: Hanayagi Kaoruko
source:
"A contest between the head of the Senka-ryu School of Dance and the rising star of the New National First Theater Troupe... I'd like to see that stage, someday."

The granddaughter of the head of the family that runs the Senka-ryu School of Japanese Dance. After graduation, she returned to Kyoto. She is a Stage Girl who lives a life of history and traditions, and will succeed the name of the 12th Head of Family, "Suisen Hanayagi". After a huge quarrel, she accepts [url=/c133944]Futaba[/url]'s chosen path and sends her on her way. She is currently considering what to do with the motorbike that Futaba left behind with her, while grumbling that it is "a bother."

[From [url=https://revuestarlight.bushiroadgames.com/en/character/kaoruko/]official website[/url]]
